name: Nudge
description: Reminders and follow-ups: /remind 2h Reply to Alice, repeating reminders, snooze, and reminders to answer a chat. Desktop alerts; never sends messages.
author: Thanapat Fungpharit

commands.name: remind
commands.help: make a reminder (/remind 2h Call Bob), or open the list; /remind help for everything

commands.name: followup
commands.help: remind me to reply to the open chat; finishes by itself when you reply

keys.help: follow up on the open chat later

settings.label: Time zone
settings.help: IANA name like Asia/Bangkok or Europe/Berlin, or UTC+7; empty means UTC

settings.label: Alerts
settings.help: where a due reminder shows up (desktop alerts follow rune's notification setting)

settings.label: Snooze (minutes)
settings.help: what s and /remind snooze N postpone by

settings.label: Hour for a day without a time
Repeat overdue alerts (minutes)
settings.help: alert again about an overdue reminder every N minutes; 0 = once

settings.label: Missed while rune was closed
settings.help: how reminders that came due while rune was closed are announced at start-up

settings.label: Missed repeats
settings.help: a repeating reminder missed while closed: one alert, or straight to the next time

settings.label: Link /remind to the open chat
settings.help: reminders made in a chat show that chat

settings.label: Finish follow-ups when I reply
settings.help: a message you send in the chat finishes its follow-up

settings.label: Quote the last message in follow-ups
settings.help: keep the last message you got in that chat with the follow-up

settings.label: Keep done reminders
settings.help: how many finished reminders stay listed; older ones are deleted
